name: Clean Sim (by IMIC)
hero_sub_es: CT-WA-003 · Reciclaje y recuperación de materiales · Colombia
pitch_en: We create and sell Eco-Simulators made from clinical residues — hyper-realistic surgical practice without large upfront investment.
pitch_es: Creamos y vendemos Eco-Simuladores hechos de residuos clínicos — práctica quirúrgica hiperrealista sin gran inversión inicial.
cta_pitch_en: Transforming residues, saving lives while training professionals.
cta_pitch_es: Transformando residuos, salvando vidas mientras formamos profesionales.

sections.head_en: Eco-Simulators for hospitals, universities, students & professionals
sections.head_es: Eco-Simuladores para hospitales, universidades, estudiantes y profesionales
sections.body_en: B2B hospitals & universities; B2C students & professionals. Deck cites ~$50K/year revenue target and simulator pricing $100 B2C / $8K B2B.
sections.body_es: B2B hospitales y universidades; B2C estudiantes y profesionales. Deck cita meta ~$50K/año ingresos y precios $100 B2C / $8K B2B.

steps.text_en: Safe learning without risk to patients.
steps.text_es: Aprendizaje seguro sin riesgo para pacientes.
